summary: Change correctly solves the stale-PR-description problem and gates are green; one low-severity finding — title can be degraded on rework when the deliverable is absent, contradicting its own comment.

findings.summary: On rework, the title always falls back to ctx.task.title when pr-title.md is absent, overwriting a diff-derived title set at creation. The body has a null=leave-unchanged guard for exactly this; the title lacks it, and the inline comment incorrectly claims the title 'is never degraded'. Fix: send title: null when readPrTitle returns null on the rework path (creation keeps the fallback since PROptions.title is non-nullable).
